gloss: to confide; to reveal; to confess

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {打|う}ち{明|あ}けませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {打|う}ち{明|あ}けていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {打|う}ち{明|あ}けていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To share a secret, personal matter, or hidden feelings with someone.
To admit something one has been hiding, often reluctantly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{明|あ}けた。
examples.english: I confided my worries to my friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ついに→ついに：02360_tsuini⟧{打|う}ち{明|あ}けた。
examples.english: He finally revealed a secret he had kept for many years.
I felt relieved after confiding feelings I couldn't tell anyone to my mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{明|あ}ける⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧んです。
examples.english: To be honest with you, I don't really understand it either.
examples.notes: ⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{明|あ}ける⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ is a fixed expression meaning 'to be honest' or 'frankly speaking'.

examples.japanese: {打|う}ち{明|あ}けて⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧だった。
examples.english: To be frank, I was against that plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ついに→ついに：02360_tsuini⟧⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ついていた→つく：noentry⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{明|あ}けて、⟦{謝|あやま}った→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧。
examples.english: He finally confessed that he had been lying and apologized.

notes:
{打|う}ち{明|あ}ける is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) formed from ⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ (to strike) + ⟦{明|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧ (to open). The image is of opening one's heart to reveal what's inside.

ASPECT (ている):
{打|う}ち{明|あ}けている is uncommon; the completed form {打|う}ち{明|あ}けた is typically used.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [person]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧[secret]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{明|あ}ける — to confide [secret] to [person]
- ⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{明|あ}ける⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ — to be honest, frankly speaking
- ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{明|あ}ける (reveal a secret)
- ⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{明|あ}ける (tell the truth)
- ⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{明|あ}ける (reveal one's feelings)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{明|あ}ける⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ or {打|う}ち{明|あ}けて⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ means "to tell the truth" or "frankly speaking" — used to introduce an honest admission.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{告白|こくはく}する→告白する：19631_kokuhakusuru⟧: to confess (especially romantic feelings)
- ⟦{白状|はくじょう}する→白状：21378_hakujou⟧: to confess (often wrongdoing)
